description: Buy an X posting add-on. action=buy: plan_code is x_posts_100 ($8/month, 100 extra posts), x_posts_250 ($18/month, 250), or x_posts_500 ($35/month, 500). Call without confirm to see the price. Show that price to the user. Nothing is charged on the preview. Then call again with confirm=true, the preview_id, and expected_addon_status, expected_plan_code, and expected_price_usd from the preview. Confirming returns a Stripe Checkout link. The card is charged only after the user pays on that page. If an add-on is already active, confirming opens the billing page for the workspace owner and does not buy a second plan. Read the allowance with get_x_posting_quota. Owner or admin. billing:write.

action.description: buy: quote an X posting add-on, then open Checkout after the user agrees.

confirm.description: True only after the user agrees, with the preview_id.

expected_addon_status.description: From the preview. The add-on status the quote was based on.

expected_plan_code.description: From the preview. The current plan code, or null when there is none.

expected_price_usd.description: From the preview. The monthly price in dollars, or null.

plan_code.description: Which add-on to buy. Not used when one is already active.

preview_id.description: The preview_id from the preview call.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID from whoami, when the key is not already scoped.

name: manage_x_posting_addon
